mods.name: AeroWeather
mods.description:
AeroWeather adds a simulated wind system to Minecraft: wind has a
direction and intensity that drifts naturally, intensifies during rain
and thunderstorms, and can be adjusted with the /aeroweather command.
Simple particles show which direction the wind is blowing from, and with
Create Aeronautics installed, wind physically pushes flying contraptions.

releases.notes:
- Added support for Cloud Layers (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cloud-layers). Cloud layers are now influenced by the wind and move at different speeds/directions depending on their height. 

- Fixed Integrated Foliage 2.2.1 compatibility. 

- Tweaked max wind speed height cap.

mods.name: AeroWeather
mods.description:
AeroWeather adds a simulated wind system to Minecraft: wind has a
direction and intensity that drifts naturally, intensifies during rain
and thunderstorms, and can be adjusted with the /aeroweather command.
Simple particles show which direction the wind is blowing from, and with
Create Aeronautics installed, wind physically pushes flying contraptions.

releases.notes:
- Added a configurable secondary wind layer near cloud height - this layer can be tweaked in the config to completely reverse direction (useful for navigation), vary on its own cycle, and change speed/direction compared to the lower layer.
- Clouds now move with the wind at their height level. By default, this serves as a visual indicator to the player to know what the speed and direction of the second wind layer are.
- Refactored configuration screens for legibility and ease of use.
